sub_answers.text: In 1977 John Grant was Chairman of the Organising Committee for the 2nd FESPIC Games held in Sydney, an event he helped establish and which followed the period immediately after the 1976 Paralympics [d37675808s4p0]. In 1980 Grant wrote to the Minister for Sport arguing for a national policy on sport for people with disabilities, and subsequently the Australian Government established a national advisory committee on sports for disabled persons of which he was a member [d37675808s4p0]. John Grant had earlier been instrumental in establishing the Junior National Wheelchair Games and held long-term leadership roles in state and national paraplegic organisations, linking his ongoing disability-sport administration to the post-1976 development of organised disability sport in Australia [d37675808s4p0] .
